metadata.description: Tanod MCP servers for agents: one plugin per focused server (security, chain, sky, finance, docs, images, text, util, web, ml, agents) plus the all-in-one server. Hosted, no API key, free daily allowance, pay per call in USDC after that.

plugins.name: tanod
plugins.description: All 143 Tanod tools in one server: security checks, chain data, aviation and space, finance, PDF and image toolkits, text, utilities, web and local ML. Pay per call in USDC over x402, or free daily allowance; no API key.

plugins.name: tanod-agents
plugins.description: Index of x402 endpoints and MCP servers (query, history, export) and agent-package scans.

plugins.name: tanod-chain
plugins.description: Ethereum and Base reads: balances, tokens, prices, quotes, gas, blocks, transactions, ENS.

plugins.name: tanod-docs
plugins.description: PDF toolkit: extract text, OCR, merge, split, rotate, compress, watermark, protect, HTML to PDF.

plugins.name: tanod-finance
plugins.description: SEC EDGAR company data, US Treasury yields, ECB FX rates, token prices, IBAN/LEI/ISIN checks.

plugins.name: tanod-images
plugins.description: Image toolkit: resize, convert, compress, crop, metadata, hashes, favicons, OCR, QR codes, barcodes.

plugins.name: tanod-ml
plugins.description: Local ML: text embeddings, reranking, similarity, named entities, zero-shot classification.

plugins.name: tanod-security
plugins.description: Contract and agent-package scans, phishing URL and OFAC checks, domain and header checks.

plugins.name: tanod-sky
plugins.description: Aviation and space data: METAR/TAF, airports, space weather, aurora, asteroids, satellite passes.

plugins.name: tanod-text
plugins.description: Text tools: stats, language, case, lines, replace, extract, keywords, summary, sentiment, diff.

plugins.name: tanod-util
plugins.description: Developer utilities: encode, hash, HMAC, IDs, JSON, data conversion, cron, time zones, QR codes.

plugins.name: tanod-web
plugins.description: Web tools: search, page to Markdown or screenshot, metadata, links, sitemaps, robots, RDAP, IP.
